photoSubjects: A large highly realistic freshly baked Dragon Pizza dominates the foreground on a premium restaurant table, with crispy blistered crust, rich melted cheese, vibrant toppings and fiery red chilies, surrounded by glowing diyas, marigold flowers, subtle golden rangoli details and sparkling festive bokeh in an elegant modern restaurant under warm golden Diwali lighting.
prompt:
Create a festive, premium Diwali promotional poster for a modern restaurant. Celebrate the festival of lights with a warm and joyful atmosphere featuring glowing diyas, elegant golden light, subtle rangoli patterns, marigold flowers, sparkling festive decorations, and a beautifully presented restaurant setting.

Make the **new Dragon Pizza launch** the main visual focus: show a large, mouth-watering, freshly baked Dragon Pizza with a crispy crust, rich melted cheese, vibrant toppings, and a slightly fiery/spicy visual theme. Make the pizza look premium, appetizing, and highly realistic.

Clearly include the following promotional information in a strong, attractive hierarchy:

**DIWALI SPECIAL**
**NEW LAUNCH: DRAGON PIZZA**
**Launching on 15 December 2026**
**50% OFF — ONE DAY ONLY**
**Use Coupon Code: DIWALI2026**

Create a festive offer badge highlighting **“50% OFF”** and make **“15 DECEMBER 2026”** highly visible so customers immediately understand that the offer is available only on that day. Use elegant Diwali-inspired typography, golden accents, rich festive tones, and a premium restaurant-advertising aesthetic. Keep all text clean, readable, correctly spelled, and visually balanced. No unnecessary text or extra promotional claims.
name: diwali_dragon_launch
idea: A premium burgundy-and-gold launch poster with a monumental pizza portrait, elegant festive lettering, an overlapping gold offer seal, and a prominent date-and-coupon footer.
